result.summary: Found 1 visual defect: metadata text under the featured restaurant overlaps and becomes unreadable.

issues.description: Under 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar', the subtitle text collides: it renders as '25-30delivery · Ramen' with the delivery-time and delivery-fee fragments overlapping, so 'min' and the fee are unreadable.
issues.suggestion: Give the meta line proper spacing or a single non-overlapping text flow so the time, delivery fee, and cuisine render on one line without collision (e.g., '25-30 min · €0 delivery · Ramen').
